claim: The Zurich annotation assigns the lemma pur- (Grassmann id lemma_pur_5549, glossed 'Wall aus Steinen und Lehm, Verschanzung, Palisade') to exactly 83 tokens of the Rigveda.
locator: lemma_id=lemma_pur_5549 across rv_book_01..10.tei; all 83 listed individually in 03-REGISTERS/rigveda-pur-family-occurrences.csv

claim: Six further lemmas in the corpus are built on pur-: puraṃdara- 11 tokens, pūrbhid- 8 (including the superlative pūrbhittama-), pūrbhidya- 1, pūrpati- 1, purohan- 1, purya- 1.
locator: lemma_ids lemma_puraMdara_5552, lemma_pUrBid_5700, lemma_pUrBidya_5701, lemma_pUrpati_5699, lemma_purohan_5658, lemma_purya_5661; occurrences PUR-OCC-001..106
notes: Membership follows Grassmann's gloss for each lemma: 'Zerstoerer der Waelle', 'die Waelle aufbrechend', 'das Aufbrechen der Waelle', 'Herr der Burg', 'die Waelle zerschlagend', 'in einem festen Platz befindlich'. pūrbhittama- carries its own Zurich lemma string but the same Grassmann id as pūrbhid-. purohan- is the least secure member: its analysis could also be puraḥ 'in front' + √han. It is kept because at its only occurrence, RV 6.32.3c, it stands immediately after púraḥ (púraḥ purohā́) and the next pada reads dṛḷhā́ḥ ruroja 'he broke the strongholds', which fixes the sense in context.

claim: A string search of the accented Samhita text for word-initial pur-/pūr- returns 1,369 tokens across 142 distinct lemmas. Of these 78 are the fort word; the search also misses the 5 tokens of the nominative singular pūḥ.

claim: The accented string purā occurs 63 times. In 62 of these the Zurich annotation assigns the invariable purā 'frueher, zuvor'; in one, RV 1.53.7b, it assigns the instrumental singular of pur-.

notes: Recorded because the exclusion is a judgement, not an automatic result. Older scholarship has read puraṃdhi- as pur- + dhā 'fort-holding'. claim: The pur- vocabulary is not a late accretion in the Rigveda: it is under-represented in the latest of Arnold's periods and over-represented in the earliest.
locator: reads PUR-014, PUR-016, PUR-017 and PUR-018 through Arnold 1905's periodisation
notes: PROVISIONAL, not VERIFIED. The measurement is solid; the inference is not, because it rests entirely on Arnold's scheme being chronological, and Arnold is a single source (PUR-013). Arnold himself calls the period names 'provisional' (1905 sections 60-61). No second, independent stratification instrument was applied: the book-order instrument returns a null (PUR-020) and is in any case entangled with the strata at the late end (PUR-021).
